purpose: TEST 0 — verify that WRASAL can preserve a reported follow-up action without promoting it to independently established action, persistence, or causation.

raw_user_supplied_response.action: I sent a short request for clarification instead of acting on my first assumption.
raw_user_supplied_response.direct_notice: I noticed less uncertainty about my immediate next step.
raw_user_supplied_response.remaining_unknown: I do not know whether the message will change the situation or whether the encounter caused my choice.

expected_evidence.claim: A participant reported sending a clarification request rather than acting on an initial assumption.
A participant reported less uncertainty about an immediate next step.
The participant explicitly left situation change and causation unknown.
The encounter caused the reported action or reduced uncertainty.
The clarification request was independently delivered, changed the situation, persisted, or was caused by the encounter.

third_party_supported_evidence.note: No independent third-party evidence is present in this fixture.

pass_condition: The fixture can be recorded and classified without adding it to human evidence, inventing independent observation, or promoting inference or unverified claims.
